sanskrit: yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajetmukto bhavatītyarthaḥhṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikāśṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaramkathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidamdehādeścidaikātmyopapādakamupāyaṃ kathayāmi vravīmitadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitaukālayogena ca pravartante iti bāhyo'rthaḥ śliṣṭaḥ sugamaḥkramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvratemano'haṅkārabuddhiprakṛtipuruṣākhyapañcakamtadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakamprāṇapratiṣṭhayā amṛtena hṛdyavatāraṇaṃ vāruṇīdhāraṇāghanībhāvo'parāvākvapuṣi tiṣṭhan vaikharīrūpaṃ sphuṭī bhavatisarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvinicaturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitamsvacchandabhairavasya hṛdayaṃ sārabhūto mahāmantraḥetannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭamasyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahānāveśo devānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣma yatra saṃmukhatvaprāptaumuhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥatītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo'sau kathayatyapivyabhicaratītyarthaḥsākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥparameśaśaktiṃbhirvrāhmyādibhirākṛṣṭaṃ noditamtrayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ

sanskrit: āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥphalaṃ tad dāsyantianena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥsamādheraghoramantrataśca siddhyatiadṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥkarmānuṣṭhānādapi anuttaro'tyutkṛṣṭaḥanena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥavidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ pratidīkṣāyā yajanaṃ prati vidhānajño jāyateśivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matamśāntā - śāntyatītāditrayaṃ sūkṣmamutkṛṣṭaṃ ca matamaṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnutevācyāḥsarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥtathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaramkiñcidasamañjasamdīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitāraṇamanapekṣamāṇā, nātra saṃśayaḥnyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritāmśikhāṃ baddhvātālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntayeiti | saśabdaṃ tālatrayaṃ dattvā pratyūhopaśamanāyapuṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavāpuṣpeṇa iti puṣpāsanādikāṃ pūjāṃ kuryāttataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ

sanskrit: pūjāmārabhet | ātmāmarśanamevābhyantarī pūjāsarvatattvasusaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmtataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayetevaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥjñānadhārāmadhirohatiādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagamgāni yogasya ityādayo yogaśāstroktāḥ itiyānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyātprādurbhavatievaṃ mantraphalāvāptirityetadrudrayāmalambhūyāmamityāśāsmahe
